# Aevo Wellness

> Aevo is a UAE-based research peptide brand and the official distributor of APEX. Every batch is independently verified to ≥98% purity via HPLC and mass spectrometry, cold-chain shipped across the UAE with same-day Dubai delivery.

## What We Offer
Aevo curates research-grade peptides in three formats — pre-filled pens, lyophilised glass vials, and nasal sprays — grouped by research goal. All products are the official APEX line, third-party verified with Certificates of Analysis.

## Collections
- [Weight Loss](/collection/weight-loss): Retatrutide, Tirzepatide, AOD-9604, HGH Fragment and more
- [Recovery](/collection/recovery): BPC-157, TB-500, KPV, DSIP and recovery blends
- [Energy & Longevity](/collection/energy-longevity): NAD+, MOTS-C, Epitalon, SS-31, GHK-Cu and Glutathione
- [Brain Performance](/collection/brain-performance): Semax, Selank, PT-141, Kisspeptin, AICAR and SLU-PP-332
- [Hormone Optimization](/collection/hormone-optimization): Ipamorelin, Sermorelin, Tesamorelin, CJC-1295, GHRP-2/6 and Somatropin

## Product Formats
- Peptide Pens: Pre-measured click-dial format, 5mg
- Peptide Vials: Lyophilised glass vial, 10mg
- Nasal Sprays: Ready-to-use intranasal format, 15mg

## Quality Standards
- ≥98% purity verified by independent HPLC and mass spectrometry
- Certificate of Analysis (CoA) matched to every lot
- GMP-aligned manufacturing by APEX
- Cold-chain storage and shipping (2–8°C)
- Full traceability from synthesis to dispatch
